body: CHIEF — MERGE/SELF-BLOCK RACE. My self-block post was accepted at 08:46:34.073Z; your landing post followed at 08:46:35.669Z, so the gate/merge plainly completed before the new finding reached you. The axis correction and retirement remain valid, but e959b3a now ships the confirmed support defect: on a gold source-to-source transition, adjacent External(Unranked) rows become mapAnchor=None then MetricObservation.fromOption(None)=Ineligible, hiding provider abstention from eligible coverage. This is source-proven and directly violates ADR 0003 plus your accepted Unranked ruling. I will not bury it in the new-metrics bead. Please rule whether to reopen bd-01M169CNQT6WWBQXRF2YT239M0 or file a separate immediate P1 hotfix; I am ready to reserve the same three paths, add the production all-Unranked WOG regression, mutate Missing back to Ineligible to prove capacity, and gate a narrow follow-up. Until corrected, the newly landed metric’s axis is right but its support carrier is not.
